title: SEC Form 8-K: Meridian Technologies Inc. Reports Q2 2024 Earnings and Strategic Acquisition
content:
UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION
Washington, D.C. 20549
FORM 8-K

CURRENT REPORT
Pursuant to Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934

Date of Report: July 30, 2024

MERIDIAN TECHNOLOGIES INC.
(Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)

Commission File Number: 001-39847
State of Incorporation: Delaware
IRS Employer ID: 84-3291056
Principal Office: 2100 Innovation Drive, Austin, TX 78701

ITEM 2.02 — RESULTS OF OPERATIONS AND FINANCIAL CONDITION

On July 30, 2024, Meridian Technologies Inc. reported financial results for Q2 2024:
- Revenue: $487.3 million (up 23% year-over-year)
- Net Income: $62.1 million (up 31% year-over-year)
- Earnings Per Share: $1.38 (diluted), vs. $1.05 in Q2 2023
- Free Cash Flow: $89.4 million
- Cloud Services ARR: $1.2 billion (up 34% year-over-year)

ITEM 8.01 — OTHER EVENTS

Meridian Technologies announced a definitive agreement to acquire DataStream Analytics, a privately held AI/ML platform company, for approximately $340 million in cash. The acquisition is expected to close in Q4 2024, subject to regulatory approvals.

Key terms:
- Purchase price: $340 million (cash consideration)
- Expected annual synergies: $45 million by Year 2
- DataStream 2024 projected revenue: $78 million
- Transaction includes $25 million employee retention pool

FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS: This report contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act. Actual results may differ materially.

SIGNATURES: Jennifer Martinez, Chief Financial Officer, July 30, 2024.
